prompt: Can I carry over unused vacation days into next year?

reply.message: Yes, up to 5 unused PTO days can carry over into the next year. Any unused days beyond 5 expire on December 31. Full-time employees accrue 20 days per year. Also, absences of 3 or more consecutive working days need 2 weeks' notice, and PTO is booked in the HR portal.

prompt: Can I work from home a few days a week?

reply.message: Yes, under POL-REM-01, office-based employees may work remotely up to 2 days a week, as long as the arrangement is agreed with your manager. Fully remote work needs VP approval. Working from another country is allowed for up to 20 working days per calendar year and needs HR approval at least 2 weeks in advance. Agree your days with your manager first, then let me know if you need any system access set up for remote work.
